description: A clean, contemporary living room photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens, using a wide establishing composition that shows the full room from a slightly elevated vantage. The ceiling is a smooth warm plaster in pale greige, with four small matte black cylindrical surface-mount spotlights positioned across its plane, and a slim warm amber cove glow running just inside the ceiling perimeter. The back wall is dominated by a large multi-panel black-framed floor-to-ceiling window with dark horizontal venetian blinds partially lowered, with long floor-to-ceiling linen curtains in warm sand hung on either side, filtering diffuse daylight from a pale overcast sky and a high urban view. The floor throughout is a herringbone parquet in pale natural light oak, warm and graphic. A large low-profile sectional sofa in warm light grey textured fabric runs along the left wall, dressed with layered cushions in mixed warm tones — brown, terracotta, and dark charcoal — adding lived-in warmth. The coffee table is a rectangular marble slab in white Carrara with grey veining, set on a low base, sitting on a large flat-pile grey area rug. On the coffee table: a grey stoneware vase with a small delicate branch, a small white sculptural object, and a few flat books. Along the right wall, a low floating media console in light warm oak veneer holds a wall-mounted flat-screen television. The overall palette is pale greige, warm oak, and grey with muted brown and terracotta accents.
